title: Properties, mass, and confinement of the Borromean baryon
html:
Remark. Properties, mass, and confinement of the Borromean baryon

Remark (properties of the Borromean link). The Borromean link \mathcal{B}_3 consists of three unknots. No two are linked, but all three together are inseparable. This provides the topological definition of confinement: constituents cannot be isolated.

The link has hyperbolic volume \mathrm{Vol}(S^3 \setminus \mathcal{B}_3) \approx 7.327. Each component has a crossing orientation contributing to the Skein polynomial. The constituent unknots and the Hopf link both have zero hyperbolic volume. The entire baryon mass originates directly from the Borromean linking.
